headline: Apple Faces Tight iPhone Duo Supplies Across Asian Retail Stores at Launch
summary: Apple launched its iPhone Duo with scarce retail inventory and no walk-in sales across much of Asia, restricting walk-in purchases to select locations like Macau with limited stock.
why: Apple is one of the world's most valuable tech firms, and hardware launch availability directly influences consumer adoption rates and quarterly device revenue.

impacts.name: Apple Inc.
impacts.why: Supply shortages may delay immediate retail conversion despite indicating solid initial launch demand.
